items.q: What should you remember about **5-minute bootstrap**?
items.a: **Obsidian vault → open in VS Code →** paste Karpathy gist + screenshot → "You are now my LLM wiki agent" → schema + first ingest.

items.q: What should you remember about **Multiple vaults inside one AIOS**?
items.a: **topic-separated wikis (YouTube vs meetings)** each with own rules; Herk2 routes agents to the right vault.

items.q: What should you remember about **wiki flat vs structured folders**?
items.a: **YouTube wiki uses concepts/entities/sources/tools subfolders; meeting** wiki stays flat until patterns emerge; flat = easier agent search at small scale.

items.q: What should you remember about **raw/ immutable → wiki/ LLM-owned**?
items.a: **one source may spawn** 5–50 pages; index + log let agents navigate incrementally.

items.q: What should you remember about **Obsidian = human IDE only**?
items.a: **agents read the same** markdown; graph view optional for browsing backlinks.

items.q: What should you remember about **Fable for ambitious synthesis, Opus/Sonnet fine for ingest**?
items.a: **Fable overkill for setup;** better for post-data creative outputs (HTML maps, branded dashboards).

items.q: What should you remember about **Fable subscription note**?
items.a: **limited window until July 7 2026 then** usage credits; Thor tweet says Anthropic plans to restore as subscription benefit (no date).

items.q: What should you remember about **Tool-agnostic markdown**?
items.a: **connect hermes agent, Codex,** or any agent; wiki is just files + routing rules.

items.q: What should you remember about **Batch vs guided ingest**?
items.a: **batch works but review** folder structure; update AGENTS.md rules if organization feels wrong.

items.q: What should you remember about **Free course**?
items.a: **full Build Your Own** AIOS course in ai automation society Skool (link in description).
